tokens.npc_dota_hero_medusa_bio: Beauty is power. This thought comforted Medusa--the youngest and loveliest of three beautiful Gorgon sisters, born to a sea goddess--because she alone of the sisters was mortal. It comforted her, that is, until the day masked assailants invaded the Gorgon realm and tore the two immortal sisters from their home, unmoved by their beauty or by their tears. One of the invaders seized Medusa as well, but then cast her aside with a disgusted look: 'This one has the mortal stink upon her. We have no use for that which dies.' Humiliated, enraged, Medusa fled to the temple of her mother and cast herself before the goddess, crying, 'You denied me eternal life--therefore I beg you, give me power! Power, so I can dedicate what life I have to rescuing my sisters and avenging this injustice!' After long thought, the goddess granted her daughter's request, allowing Medusa to trade her legendary beauty for a face and form of terrifying strength. Never for a moment has Medusa regretted her choice. She understands that power is the only beauty worth possessing--for only power can change the world.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_medusa_hype: Constant attack is the key to Medusa's success. Using her mana shield to stave off assault, she employs split shots to mow down waves of enemies. Once she gathers her full strength, she becomes a force powerful enough to stop anyone in their tracks.

* Acquiring {{M|Aghanim's Shard}} unlocks this ability in the {{Spellslot|4|5}}.

* The ability utilizes the {{M|Spell Block}} mechanic — abilities that do not proc Spell Block, do not proc Cold Blooded.
** However, this ability component does not interact with Spell Block sources.
** Procs as long as the passive ability is off-{{M|cooldown}}.
** Does not proc on abilities cast from {{Code|> {{#var:Cold Blooded value1}}}}-distance. The effective area for the max proc distance is [[File:Dota2 Area Half-Circle Bottom icon.png|20px|Area-of-effect visualized.]] half of a [[Wikipedia:Sphere|sphere]] and not a flat circle.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
** Releases {{A|Medusa|Mystic Snake}} corresponding to its level upon proc as follows:
**# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
**# {{Symbol|Stun}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{A|Medusa|Stone Gaze}}
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Bounce-to}}
*** Does not consider itself as a bounce on the target affected by the following mechanics:
**** Upon {{M|death}}.
**** Becomes {{M|hidden}}.
**** Becomes {{M|invulnerable}}.
**** Becomes {{M|spell immune}}.
*** In the aforementioned conditions, the [[projectile]] may bounce to another target.
Illusions absorb less damage per point of mana.

* Mana Shield has the highest precedence in the group of [[damage manipulation]] effects.
** As long as Medusa has {{M|current mana}}, Mana Shield precedes '''all''' damage manipulation mechanics.
** Affects all [[damage types]] Medusa receive, this includes the following sources:
*** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
*** [[Setting health]] sources.
*** {{M|Current health}} as ability cost sources.
** The damage reduction ability effects are applied as follows:
**# Reduces {{M|incoming damage}} ([[before reductions]]).
**# Applies the reduced damage instance.
**# [[Mana#Setting Mana|Setting]] Medusa's {{M|current mana}} based on the damage to mana factor value.
**#* Does not interact with [[mana loss manipulation]] sources.

* Applies a unique {{M|incoming damage}} manipulation on Medusa.
** Stacks multiplicatively with other incoming damage manipulation sources.

* In short, Medusa loses the following health and mana per 100 damage taken:
** {{M|Current health}}: {{calc|(1-v1)*100|v1={{#var:Mana Shield value1}}}}<sub>HP</sub>
** {{M|Current mana}}:
*** {{Symbol|HeroLvl|1}} {{calc|100/(v1+v2*1)*{{#var:Mana Shield value1}} round3|v1={{#var:Mana Shield value2}}|v2={{#var:Mana Shield basic1}}}}<sub>MP</sub>
*** {{#invoke:Lua|invoke|module=loop|fn=lvl|1|5|<nowiki>{{Symbol|HeroLvl|{{#expr:{{#var:lvl}}*6}}}} {{calc|100/(v1+v2*{{#var:lvl}}*6)*{{#var:Mana Shield value1}} round3|v1={{#var:Mana Shield value2}}|v2={{#var:Mana Shield basic1}}}}<sub>MP</sub>
*** </nowiki>}}
** {{Symbol|Illusions}}
*** Directly sets Medusa's [[illusions]]' current mana, and they do not lose health until its current mana is depleted.

mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}}
** The [[toggle]] status persists {{M|death}}.
** Does not interrupt Medusa's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
** Not affected by {{M|silence}} sources.
** Does not break {{M|invisible}} sources on Medusa.

* The ability has three main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Toggle|On}}
*** Reduces both Medusa's {{M|main attack damage|text=main}} and {{M|bonus attack damage}}, and is defined as:
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Current Σ[[Attack Damage|Atk]] {{=}} ([[Main Attack Damage|MainAtk]] + [[Bonus Attack Damage|BonusAtk]]) × AtkDmgFactor}}
*** Does not affect bonus {{M|conditional attack damage}}.
*** Stacks additively with other total attack damage reduction sources.
*** The reduction value displayed on the [[HUD]] is inaccurate.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Has the following properties when attacking the primary target upon Medusa's {{M|attack point}}:
**** All attack [[projectile]]s are launched at the same time to, and [[instant attack]] valid secondary targets within the {{Symbol|bonus atk}} search radius.
**** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
***** Does not release additional [[instant attack]] projectiles upon attacking {{M|allied units|x}}.
***** {{Symbol|Projectile|Speed}}
****** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|ProjectileSpeed {{=}} Self AtkProjectileSpeed}}
***** The instant attack projectile neither procs {{M|attack modifiers}} nor {{M|on-cast effects}}.
****** {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} removes this restriction.
***** Does not have {{M|True Strike}}.
***** Affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
***** However, certain sources still interact differently with Split Shot:
****** {{A|Silver Edge|Shadow Walk}} applies {{M|break}} to only the primary target and the secondary target nearest to Medusa.
****** {{I|Witch Blade}}-based damage per second is only applied to the nearest attacked target upon triggering its cooldown.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]]
*** The search radius has the following properties:
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|SecondaryAtk SearchRadius {{=}} Hero[[Attack Range|AtkRange]] + {{#expr:{{#var:Split Shot value1}}-{{Show|H|Medusa|atkrange}}}}}}
**** Not affected by {{M|cast range|x}} sources.
**** Affected by {{M|attack range}} sources of the same range-type as the caster.
*** The {{M|instant attack}} projectiles do not target the following units:
**** {{M|Attack immune}} units.
**** {{M|Buildings}}
**** {{M|Fogged units}}.
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.
**** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
*** However, attacking the following units still causes secondary arrows to hit valid units within the seearch radius.
**** {{M|Buildings|x}}
**** {{M|Ward-type units|x}}.

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
** The enemy team '''must''' have [[vision]] over Medusa for a min 1 {{M|server tick}}. If else, Stone Gaze does nothing.
*** Upon fulfilling this prerequisite, the ability creates a negative {{M|aura}} centered around Medusa's vision radius, and through the {{M|Fog of War}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Circular Sector 170 (Facing) icon.png|105px|Stone Gaze Angle]]
*** Once activated, the enemy unit [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} is considered facing Medusa, [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]], within {{#expr:{{#var:Stone Gaze basic1}}*2}}° of its [[Wikipedia:Circular segment|circular segment]], regardless of the enemy unit's facing angle, within the effect radius.

* The ability has three main components upon ability activation.
** {{hi|Medusa}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|l}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** The following components are applied to enemy units facing Medusa within the {{M|aura}} radius:
**** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|medusa_stone_gaze_facing}} {{to}} {{Symbol|a|Counter}}
***** Accumulates the total duration the enemy unit faces Medusa.
***** Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|medusa_stone_gaze_stone}} on the affected enemy units once the timer accumulates {{#var:Stone Gaze type1 value1}} seconds.
***** Does not reset the facing timer in the following conditions:
****** The enemy unit facing away from Medusa once the timer is applied.
****** Becomes {{M|hidden}}.
****** Becomes {{M|invulnerable}}.
**** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Code|medusa_stone_gaze_slow}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|l}} {{hi|Medusa}}
***** This debuff is applied explicitly while facing Medusa, with the following ability effects:
****** The {{M|movement speed}} slow.
****** The flat {{M|attack speed}} slow.
****** The {{M|turn rate}} slow.
***** Does not affect enemy units facing away from Medusa.
****** However, facing away does not {{M|dispel}} the debuff. 
***** Does not affect the following units:
****** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|21px|3]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|medusa_stone_gaze_stone}}
**** Applies the following ability effects:
***** {{M|Stun}}
***** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
****** Freezes the affected enemy unit's animations.
***** {{M|Incoming damage|t=n|text=incoming}} {{M|physical}} damage amplification.
****** Stacks additively with other incoming damage manipulation sources.
****** Amplifies all physical damage instance applied on affected units, and not other [[damage types]].
****** Affects the following sources:
******* {{M|Physical|x}} {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
****** Does not affect the following units:
******* {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*** Both [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] and [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] debuffs' duration have the following properties:
**** The duration last as long as the facing time, or until {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|medusa_stone_gaze_stone}} is applied on the affected enemy unit.
**** Both components are independent of the {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|medusa_stone_gaze_stone}}, and can be reapplied only when the {{Code|stone}} component expires.
***** This repeats until the gaze duration ends, so long the unit {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} faces Medusa.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_medusa
data.bio_loc: Beauty is power. This thought comforted Medusa--the youngest and loveliest of three beautiful Gorgon sisters, born to a sea goddess--because she alone of the sisters was mortal. It comforted her, that is, until the day masked assailants invaded the Gorgon realm and tore the two immortal sisters from their home, unmoved by their beauty or by their tears. One of the invaders seized Medusa as well, but then cast her aside with a disgusted look: 'This one has the mortal stink upon her. We have no use for that which dies.' Humiliated, enraged, Medusa fled to the temple of her mother and cast herself before the goddess, crying, 'You denied me eternal life--therefore I beg you, give me power! Power, so I can dedicate what life I have to rescuing my sisters and avenging this injustice!' After long thought, the goddess granted her daughter's request, allowing Medusa to trade her legendary beauty for a face and form of terrifying strength. Never for a moment has Medusa regretted her choice. She understands that power is the only beauty worth possessing--for only power can change the world.
data.hype_loc: Constant attack is the key to Medusa's success. Using her mana shield to stave off assault, she employs split shots to mow down waves of enemies. Once she gathers her full strength, she becomes a force powerful enough to stop anyone in their tracks.

abilities.name: medusa_split_shot
abilities.desc_loc:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
abilities.lore_loc: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.
notes_loc: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
abilities.scepter_loc: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

abilities.name: medusa_mystic_snake
abilities.desc_loc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
abilities.lore_loc: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.
facets_loc: Mystic Snakes returning to Medusa empower her next %max_attacks% attacks with +1 additional damage for each %mana_per_damage% mana restored. Lasts up to %attack_buff_duration%s.

abilities.name: medusa_gorgon_grasp
abilities.desc_loc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
abilities.lore_loc: The best predators don't even need to pounce.

abilities.name: medusa_cold_blooded
abilities.desc_loc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.
abilities.lore_loc: Point your gaze at her if you dare.

abilities.desc_loc: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
abilities.lore_loc: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.
notes_loc: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.
facets_loc: Mana Shield can be activated, draining %aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%% of max mana per second to gain %aspd_increase_rate_pct%%% attack speed bonus per second, up to %aspd_increase_max_tooltip%%%.
